title: Quiz on User Stories and Acceptance Criteria

questions.text: According to the reference material, what is the standard format for a User Story?
questions.explanation: The document explicitly states the format: 'As a (type of user), I want to (perform some action) so that I (can achieve some goal/result/value).'

answers.text: As a (type of user), I want to (perform some action) so that I (can achieve some goal/result/value).
Given (a context), When (an event occurs), Then (an outcome).
I need to (do something) because (of a reason).
The system shall (perform a function) to (meet a requirement).

questions.text: For agile teams, what is the primary method identified by User Stories, according to the provided text?
questions.explanation: The text states: 'Para los equipos ágiles, User Stories son el primer método para identificar necesidades de los usuarios.'

answers.text: To identify user needs.
To define the project's technical architecture.
To track software bugs and defects.
To manage the project budget and resources.

questions.text: How do Acceptance Criteria ensure the correct completion of User Stories?
questions.explanation: The text asks: '¿Cómo nos aseguramos de que las User Stories se han completado correctamente y conforme a las demandas de los clientes?' and then immediately introduces 'Acceptance criteria' as the answer.

answers.text: By defining the conditions that must be met for a User Story to be considered complete and satisfactory to the client.
By outlining the user interface design specifications.
By prioritizing which User Stories should be developed first.
By estimating the development effort required for each User Story.

questions.text: In the context of Behavior-Driven Development (BDD), what do 'behavior specs' ultimately become?
questions.explanation: The text states: 'Behavior specs se convierten en los requisitos, los criterios de aceptación y las pruebas de aceptación.'

answers.text: Requirements, acceptance criteria, and acceptance tests.
Only the system's functional requirements.
Only the acceptance tests for the software.
Only the design documentation for the user interface.

questions.text: Based on the BDD guidelines for scenario titles, which of the following is considered a good practice?
questions.explanation: The BDD section advises to 'Evita palabras “verify”, “assert” o “should” en títulos de escenarios.' and provides 'The right way' examples like 'Profile page address change.'

answers.text: Profile page address change.
Verify the user can change their address on the profile page.
Assert that a stock quote is displayed in green text.
The goodbye page should be displayed after a successful logout.
